file: 374 This Roblox Game Had More Players Than Fortnite Ever Did.mp4

lines.t: This Roblox game had more people playing at once than Fortnite ever did.

full.credit: Clips: LazarLazar; Dope Gameplays (Roblox gameplay, YouTube)

lines.t: Fortnite's biggest peak was about 15 million players, back in 2020.

full.credit: Clips: LazarLazar; Dope Gameplays (Roblox gameplay, YouTube)

lines.t: In October 2025, Steal a Brainrot hit 25 point 4 million players at the same time.

full.credit: Clips: LazarLazar; Dope Gameplays (Roblox gameplay, YouTube)

lines.t: That's a record for any single game. One game, on Roblox, about stealing brainrots.

full.credit: Clips: LazarLazar; Dope Gameplays (Roblox gameplay, YouTube)

lines.t: Do you still play Steal a Brainrot?

full.credit: Clips: LazarLazar; Dope Gameplays (Roblox gameplay, YouTube)
